name_input: SBL SPECIALTY COATINGS PRIVATE LIMITED; SABOO COATINGS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export (outbound) shipment record found for either entity. The only customs data retrieved is INBOUND into India: ImportKey page for SBL SPECIALTY COATINGS PRIVATE LIMITED shows "Total Shipments 187 Records detected", "Trading Partners 6", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-03", with rows such as "2026-02-03 | COLOREEZE GROUP LIMITED | SBL SPECIALTY COATINGS PRIVATE LIMITED | PTFE RESIN BASED COATING MATERIAL, BASE COAT ... | Shekou, CHINA -> PATPARGANJ ICD INPPG6, India | 32100040 | BOL 7292351" and "2026-01-18 | CHEMICAL MARKETING CONCEPTS EUROPE | SBL SPECIALTY COATINGS PRIVATE LIMITED | MACRYNAL(R) SM 2703/80BACX, ACRYLIC RESINS ... | AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL, NETHERLANDS -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC, India | 39069090 | BOL 6965117". All 5 visible rows are imports with India as destination; no row shows India as origin/destination of export. Source counter: page claims 187 shipments; rows actually seen = 5 (all import).
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the customs evidence proves this is an IMPORTER of coating raw materials (PTFE resin base/top coat from Coloreeze Group China, acrylate oligomer from Sartomer Guangzhou, acrylic resins from CMC Europe, silica coating liquid from KMTR Korea), not an exporter. No export bill of lading, no destination country outside India, no export HS line was found for either SBL Specialty Coatings or Saboo Coatings. Saboo Coatings Private Limited: ImportKey page exists but is fully paywalled/empty — no shipment count, no rows, no dates; nothing to cite. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be checked: web_search returned 'searx: Connection refused' on every attempt, and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in retrieved sources; not invented). Declared HS 320890/320910/390690 partially matches observed import lines 39069090 (acrylic resins) and 32100040 (paints/varnishes), but 38249900 also appears repeatedly and is outside the declared set — per project rules this is NOT grounds for rejection; record actual codes as observed. No rejection: legal existence not disproven. No sanctions/court/owner-criminal matters were checked or are relevant to the verdict. Recommended follow-up: re-run with working search to obtain GST turnover and GeM/CPPP records, and confirm whether SBL Specialty Coatings is a manufacturer or trader (imports of finished base/top coat suggest possible trader or reformulator role).
